title: Women's Owl – Night Owl, Retired Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Owl Zip Up Hoodie – Night Owl, Retired
seo.description: An owl zip up hoodie: NIGHT OWL, RETIRED on the back around a sleepy owl in a nightcap, plus an embroidered owl on a branch under a moon on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This owl zip up hoodie is for the night owl who has retired from late nights and is in bed by nine, zipped on for the evening walk and the early couch.

A sleepy owl in a striped nightcap and scarf perches on a pine branch under a crescent moon with half-closed eyes, in rust, cream, sage and mustard with a worn print texture. NIGHT OWL, runs above it and RETIRED below in heavy slab capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: cream and orange on Black and Navy, brown and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small sleepy owl on a branch under a moon is embroidered on the left chest, and the word 9PM is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest owl on a branch and left-cuff 9PM, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Night Owl, Retired zip hoodie fit?
The Night Owl, Retired owl zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this owl hoodie warm enough for cool evening walks?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool evening walks, early couch nights and the walk to bed well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, NIGHT OWL, above the art and RETIRED below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small sleepy owl on a branch under a moon sits on the left chest with no words, and 9PM is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The owl on a branch on the chest and the 9PM cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for an early-to-bed friend, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who calls 9 p.m. a late night. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
